strands.name: Rise
strands.text: Jobs, skills and an empowered future

programs.name: Recovery Housing & Rapid Re-Housing
programs.short: Our 28-bed flagship on N Tamiami Trail, with intensive case management linking residents to healthcare, jobs and education.
body: Our flagship program offers safe, dignified transitional housing with wrap-around services. The residence at 1389 N Tamiami Trail has 14 private rooms (28 beds), an auxiliary building with two more bedrooms, a resource center, a food pantry, and outreach and case management offices.
Placements are coordinated with United Way Lee County, the Lee County Homeless Coalition and the Continuum of Care, with shelter diversion support for people who can stay housed with the right help.

programs.name: Rope of Allah
programs.short: Faith-based community engagement — speaker events, interfaith gatherings and the donor family that sustains our work.
body: Our faith-based program brings the community into the work: fundraising, speaking at masjids and community centers, national awareness, interfaith dialogue, outreach and education, and building the donor family that keeps our doors open.
The Rope of Allah stands for divine support and human solidarity. Like everything we do, it serves people of every background with dignity and respect.

programs.name: Mobile Health Clinic
programs.short: On-site A1C, cholesterol and blood-pressure testing, nutrition education and diabetic counseling in underserved neighborhoods.
body: A mobile clinic that brings care to the parts of Lee County that need it most, so a missed bus or a missed shift doesn't mean a missed diagnosis.

programs.name: Yasamine's Place
programs.short: A respite home for single mothers with babies under two facing homelessness — housing, mental-health support and job training.
body: A mother-baby home for single mothers with babies under two who face imminent homelessness, and for families at risk of eviction or displacement.
needs: Childcare, lactation and mental health professionals
